subject: Helix Health: batch rights intake — controller/processor mapping & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Priya Sinha <privacy@helixhealth.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Batch DSR: Deletion + controller confirmation request

Hi Logan,

We are initiating a bulk deletion request for a cohort of users tied to an internal data tidy-up. Attached is a CSV (helix_dsr_batch.csv) with the user identifiers and the scope (profile data + customer-generated content). We need Redwood to: 1) confirm whether Redwood is acting as controller or processor for these records, 2) confirm the exact retention buckets/logs that will be retained for audit, and 3) provide evidence that the deletion can be performed and proof once complete (export bundle + deletion proof).

We also have standard evidence requests for our compliance review — copy of signed DPA and SCCs in effect, recent SOC 2 snapshot or link, and CAIQ/SIG high-level responses. Can you confirm timelines? We are aiming for completion within three business days if feasible.

Attached: helix_dsr_batch.csv

Thanks,
Priya Sinha
Privacy Manager, Helix Health
privacy@helixhealth.com

--
Helix Health — privacy-team@helixhealth.com

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Batch DSR: Deletion + controller confirmation request

Hi Priya — thanks for the CSV and context. Looping in Karthik (Privacy Ops) and Neha (Data Engineering) to validate scope and run the export/delete.

Initial plan:
- Today: Acknowledge receipt and run identifier validation (Neha).
- 1 business day: Confirm controller/processor mapping per dataset and provide list of locations/logs that may persist beyond deletion (e.g., backups, audit logs).
- 2-3 business days: Deliver deletion export bundle and deletion proof artifacts (sha256 manifest + activity log).

For evidence: we can provide a signed DPA and our SCCs PDF immediately (I have a stub attached). SOC 2 evidence typically requires providing a share link to our compliance portal — we will provide a short-lived link. For SIG/CAIQ we have a condensed CSV of control mappings and exported evidence pointers.

Please confirm: 1) that the CSV contains only Helix tenant identifiers (no shared resources), and 2) whether you require pseudonymized proofs or redaction of any fields in the export bundle.

Thanks — I’ll update by EOD after Karthik/Neha take a look.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.example.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.example.com>, Priya Sinha <privacy@helixhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Batch DSR: Deletion + controller confirmation request

Thanks Logan/Priya — investigated sample lines from the CSV. Quick notes: 
- Controller/Processor mapping: For the Helix tenant on hosted Redwood, Helix is Controller for end-user data; Redwood acts as Processor for customer-provided content and profiles stored within the tenant. There are exceptions where logs/aggregated telemetry are processed as Controller for Redwood operational needs — we will enumerate exact retention windows.
- Retention windows: Primary user data will be removed from live stores within our standard pipeline (target: 24–48 hours). Backups: we retain immutable backups for 30 days; deletion requests exclude backups until the backup expiration window unless a legal hold/extended erasure is requested. Audit logs: authentication and billing traces are retained for 90 days for security/finance.
- Deletion proof: We will produce an export bundle (manifest.csv + records/), a deletion activity log with job IDs, and a signed SHA256 manifest. For Helix, we can also provide a pseudonymized sample of 10 records for verification prior to final export to reduce data exposure risk.

Attachments (provided): SIG-evidence-summary.csv (control index + evidence pointers), dsr_export_helix_instructions.pdf (how we will package exports).

Open items for Helix:
1) Confirm you accept backup retention policy (30 days) and audit log retention (90 days). If you require immediate removal from backups, we need an approved legal/contractual exception (timeline ~7-10 business days).
2) Confirm required fields in export (full PII vs limited).

I will assign an internal job and share job IDs once Neha kicks off the export/delete.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Privacy & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com>
To: Priya Sinha <privacy@helixhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>

Priya — I validated the identifiers and they match an active Helix tenant cohort. Next steps from engineering:
- Step 1 (today): Start a dry-run export for 10 sample IDs and share a pseudonymized sample (expected within 3 hours).
- Step 2 (business day 1): Full export + staged deletion job (deletes from live stores).
- Step 3 (business day 2–3): Deletion from processing caches and final manifest generation; confirmation email with job IDs and signed manifest.

Authentication: We need an authorized request form signed by your legal point of contact (DocuSign link below). The doc confirms requester authority to act on behalf of Helix for this tenant. Once signed we’ll initiate the full job.

DocuSign: https://secure.docusign.com/req/ABC123-helix-authority
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/PRIV-214

Attachments referenced: dsr_export_helix_instructions.pdf

If Helix confirms acceptance of the backup/audit retention windows above, we will proceed with the job immediately after the signed form.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor

Thanks everyone — we reviewed the mapping and the proposed plan. Helix accepts the backup (30 day) and audit-log (90 day) retention windows for this intake. We will sign the DocuSign authority for this job and return it within the hour. Please proceed with the pseudonymized sample and share the SOC 2 portal link and SIG/CAIQ CSV as soon as possible.

A couple of asks for evidence chain:
- Please include the DPA effective date and the SCC template version in the PDF (we need to reference the signed templates in our records).
- For deletion proof, include the internal job IDs and a timestamped activity log with the operator account that executed the job.

We’re available for a 20-min sync if needed — otherwise proceed per the plan.

Regards,
Priya Sinha
Privacy Manager, Helix Health
privacy@helixhealth.com
